analysis.headline: Shares Your Data for Marketing
analysis.quote: With Cisco business partners or vendors, so that they may share information with you about their products or services. To opt out of Cisco sharing with third parties for their marketing purposes, please submit a Privacy Request.

analysis.headline: Collects Communications Content
analysis.quote: Communications content (such as audio, video, text), social media and discussion forum, or other communications details when you interact with Cisco;

analysis.headline: Collects IP, MAC, Telemetry Data
analysis.quote: Information about the user and usage of our websites and Solutions, including System Information such as device identifiers and telemetry (such as IP or MAC address) when such data is linked or tied to a specific individual’s device.

analysis.headline: Uses Cookies for Targeted Ads
analysis.quote: Our third-party partners may use cookies or similar technologies to provide you with advertising based on your browsing activities and interests.

analysis.headline: Transfers Your Data Globally
analysis.quote: As Cisco is a global organization, Personal Data may be transferred to Cisco in the United States of America, to any Cisco subsidiary worldwide, or to third parties and business partners as described above that are located in various jurisdictions around the world.

analysis.headline: Public Forum Data Uncontrolled
analysis.quote: If you participate in a discussion forum, local communities, or chat room on a Cisco website, you should be aware that the information you provide there (such as your public profile and comments) will be made broadly available to others and could be used to contact you, to send you unsolicited messages, or for purposes neither Cisco nor you have control over.

analysis.headline: Automated Decision Making Mentioned
analysis.quote: Where an individual's rights and legitimate interests may be impacted by such automated decision-making, we will provide the impacted individual the opportunity to inquire about the decision or request manual review.

analysis.headline: Retains Data for Business Needs
analysis.quote: We will retain and use your Personal Data as necessary to comply with our business requirements and legal obligations, resolve disputes, protect our assets, and enforce our rights and agreements.
